title: Checkout requires an email before payment
guardrails: Never submit a real payment; stop at the payment form.

testCases.title: Empty email blocks payment

steps.action: Add SKU-TEST-001 to the cart and open checkout
Leave the email empty and press Continue

testCases.expected: Payment form stays locked until an email is entered.

testCases.title: Members on mobile see the same rule

steps.action: Repeat TC-1 signed in as a member on mobile; enter the coupon code if asked

testCases.expected: The rule does not depend on device or account type.
